# Configuration

All services are configured with environment variables. They are validated at startup and
every problem is reported at once (`invalid_config`).

## Facilitator (`apps/facilitator`)

Unknown networks in `NETWORKS` and invalid asset ids in `ASSETS_*` are rejected at startup.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `HOST` | string | `127.0.0.1` | Interface to listen on. Keep 127.0.0.1 unless the facilitator sits behind a TLS proxy. |
| `PORT` | number | `4021` | HTTP port. |
| `DB_PATH` | string | `./data/facilitator.db` | SQLite database file (Prisma). One facilitator process per file (exclusive lock). |
| `PACKAGE_KEY_FILE` | string | `./data/package.key` | File with the 32-byte key (base64) that encrypts stored channel packages; created with mode 0600 if missing. Keep it out of database backups/copies. |
| `NETWORKS` | list (comma-separated) | `obyte:testnet` | Comma-separated CAIP-2 networks to serve: obyte:testnet, obyte:livenet. |
| `HUB_URL_LIVENET` | string | — | Obyte hub WebSocket URL for livenet (default: the public hub). |
| `HUB_URL_TESTNET` | string | — | Obyte hub WebSocket URL for testnet (default: the public testnet hub). |
| `ASSETS_LIVENET` | list (comma-separated) | `base` | Comma-separated assets accepted on livenet: base (GBYTE) and/or asset ids. |
| `ASSETS_TESTNET` | list (comma-separated) | `base` | Comma-separated assets accepted on testnet. |
| `FINALITY` | `stable` \| `accepted` | `stable` | When /settle reports success: stable (unit is on the stable main chain, proven) or accepted (broadcast and accepted by the hub; faster, reversible on a double-spend). |
| `HUB_TIMEOUT_MS` | number | `15000` | Timeout of one hub request. A timeout is an unknown outcome, never a failure. |
| `PUBLISH_WINDOW_SECONDS` | number | `300` | How long a verified unit may wait for settlement before it is refused. |
| `MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS` | number | `120` | Allowed difference between unit timestamps and the facilitator clock. |
| `MAX_LAST_BALL_AGE_SECONDS` | number | `10800` | Oldest last ball an exact payment unit may reference. With few transactions the network stabilizes slowly (up to ~2 h is normal); freshness of the payment itself is guaranteed by the offer binding. |
| `RECOVERY_INTERVAL_MS` | number | `5000` | How often pending settlements are re-checked in the background. |
| `BODY_LIMIT_BYTES` | number | `65536` | Maximum request body size. |
| `FACILITATOR_ADDRESSES` | list (comma-separated) | `(empty)` | Comma-separated Obyte addresses the facilitator operator controls; a payment whose payer is one of them is refused. |
| `FACILITATOR_API_KEYS` | list (comma-separated) | `(empty)` | Comma-separated shared keys for /verify and /settle (Authorization: Bearer). Empty = open: bind to localhost only. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | number | `600` | Requests per minute per client to /verify and /settle (0 = unlimited). |
| `BATCH_ENABLED` | `0` \| `1` \| `true` \| `false` | `1` | Serve the batch-settlement scheme (payment channels). |
| `MIN_CHANNEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | number | `3600` | Smallest channel dispute window the facilitator accepts. |
| `WATCHER_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS` | number | `5000` | How long /settle waits for the seller watcher to store a voucher; after that the payment is reported as settlement_pending. |
| `WATCHER_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_MS` | number | `45000` | A watcher that has not sent a heartbeat for this long is considered offline. |
| `WATCHER_MIN_BYTES` | integer | `100000` | Minimum bytes a seller watcher must hold for defense transactions before channel payments are accepted. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `fatal` \| `error` \| `warn` \| `info` \| `debug` \| `trace` | `info` | Default log level: trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal, silent. |
| `LOG_LEVELS` | string | — | Per-module levels, e.g. "exact=debug,hub=warn". |
| `LOG_PRETTY` | string | — | 1 = human-readable logs (development); default is JSON lines. |

## Seller watcher (`apps/watcher`)

Run one watcher per seller address. It uses the wallet created by `obbyx init` in `OBBYX_HOME`.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `NETWORK` | string | `obyte:testnet` | Network of the seller channels: testnet, livenet or a CAIP-2 id. |
| `FACILITATOR_URL` | string | `http://127.0.0.1:4021` | Facilitator base URL; the watcher connects to its /watcher WebSocket. |
| `HUB_URL` | string | — | Obyte hub WebSocket URL (default: the public hub of NETWORK). |
| `DB_PATH` | string | `./data/watcher.db` | SQLite database with the stored vouchers (Prisma). Losing it can lose earned funds. |
| `OBBYX_HOME` | string | `~/.obbyx` | Directory with the seller wallet (wallet-&lt;network&gt;.json, created by `obbyx init`). |
| `CLOSE_AT_AMOUNT` | integer | `1000000` | Close (cash out) a channel once the unclaimed amount reaches this many bytes. |
| `CLOSE_AFTER_SECONDS` | number | `86400` | Close a channel that has unclaimed payments older than this. |
| `POLL_INTERVAL_MS` | number | `15000` | How often channels are re-checked on the ledger (in addition to push events). |
| `HUB_TIMEOUT_MS` | number | `15000` | Timeout of one hub request. |

## Demo seller (`apps/demo`)

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PORT` | number | `3402` | HTTP port (3402 because 3000 is often taken by dev servers). |
| `HOST` | string | `127.0.0.1` | Interface to listen on. |
| `NETWORK` | string | `obyte:testnet` | CAIP-2 network of the offers. |
| `FACILITATOR_URL` | string | `http://127.0.0.1:4021` | Facilitator base URL. |
| `FACILITATOR_API_KEY` | string | — | Key sent as Authorization: Bearer if the facilitator requires one (its FACILITATOR_API_KEYS). |
| `PAY_TO` | string | **required** | Required. Seller Obyte address that receives the payments. |
| `SELLER_ID` | string | `obbyx-demo` | Seller id, part of every payment binding. |
| `SELLER_SECRET` | string | **required** | Required. HMAC secret for payment bindings (32+ chars). Rotating it invalidates open quotes. |
| `DB_PATH` | string | `./data/demo-proofs.db` | SQLite file with consumed payment proofs. |
| `BATCH_MIN_CHANNEL_TIMEOUT` | number | — | Enable channel payments (needs the seller watcher running): minimum dispute window, seconds. |
| `PLAYGROUND_BUYER_HOME` | string | — | Enables /playground: OBBYX_HOME of a TESTNET buyer wallet that pays for playground runs. Testnet and loopback HOST only. |
| `HUB_URL` | string | — | Obyte hub WebSocket URL for the playground buyer (default: the network hub). |

## CLI (`obbyx`)

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OBBYX_HOME` | `~/.obbyx` | Wallet directory (keys are stored with mode 0600). |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `warn` | Logging to stderr. |
